title: Invoices
subtitle: Manage your quotes and invoices

pdf.legalMentions: This document was generated electronically. Please retain it for your records.
pdf.creditNoteFor: Credit note for invoice no. {number} dated {date}

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.description: Create your first quote or invoice to get started.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete document
deleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete this document? This action cannot be undone.

readOnlyNotice: Read-only: the Invoicing module is inactive. Your existing documents stay available; creating and editing are disabled.

email.subject: {kindTitle} {number} from {orgName}

html.attachment: The PDF document is attached to this email.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: An issued invoice is locked: its amounts, number and issue date can no longer be changed. Only the payment date and method can still be corrected here.
payment.paidAtHint: Leave empty to cancel the recorded payment.

lockedNotice: Issued invoice: it can no longer be edited. Only its payment date and method can still be corrected; anything else needs a credit note.

onlinePayment.title: Online payment
onlinePayment.linkHint: Your customer pays this invoice by card from this link, already included in the email and the PDF. The invoice switches to “Paid” as soon as Stripe confirms the payment.
onlinePayment.noLinkHint: This invoice was sent without a payment link. Create it so your customer can pay online.

public.title: Invoice payment
public.heading: Invoice {number}
public.paid: This invoice has been paid. Thank you!
public.processing: Payment received: confirmation may take a moment. You will receive a receipt by email.
public.unavailable: Online payment is not available for this invoice. Contact {orgName} to pay it.
public.secured: Payment secured by Stripe. Your card details never go through FleetAi.
public.invalidBody: This link does not match any invoice. Check that it was copied in full, or contact the company that sent it.

creditNote.lockedNotice: Issued credit note: it can no longer be edited. Only its refund can be recorded here.

card.title: Credit notes
card.empty: No credit note issued on this invoice.
card.hint: An issued invoice cannot be edited: to fix an amount, grant a discount or cancel the invoice, issue a credit note.

form.title: Issue a credit note
form.subtitle: For invoice {number} — total {total}
form.intro: The credit note takes the client, currency and VAT rate of the invoice. It is issued immediately and gets its own number (AV-…). Remove or adjust lines for a partial credit note.
form.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. wrong amount, commercial discount, reservation cancelled…
form.exceeds: The credit note exceeds what remains to be credited on the invoice.
form.empty: The credit note must carry a positive amount.

refund.title: Refund
refund.description: A credit note is an issued document: its amounts can no longer be edited. If the client had already paid the invoice, record the refund here.
refund.paidAtHint: Leave empty to cancel the recorded refund.
